如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “究竟是什么？”有人好奇的问道。
“难道苏柔长老要献身么？”更有不要脸的，竟想入非非。
苏柔虽是长老，但却只有20岁，相比于宗门内的老古董，她更平易近人，正因如此，许多人说话才会毫无顾忌。
对于众人的猜想，苏柔只是妩媚一笑，伸出五根纤细的手指，道：“五株仙灵草。”
“什么？五株仙灵草？”
“我没听错吧？竟是仙灵草，还是五株？”此话一出，大殿一片混乱，所有人都无法淡定了。
仙灵草何其珍贵，就连楚家，每年也只能补贴每人一株而已。
而对于普通人来说，那仙灵草更是无价之宝，见都没有见过。
眼下青龙宗竟然拿出五株，这对于外门弟子来说，诱惑不可谓不大。
只不过对于大部分人来说，也只能想想，因为他们都知道那仙灵草与他们无缘。
倒是那些，目标直指第一的弟子们，一个个跃跃欲试，更加激动起来。
见弟子们气势如此高涨，苏柔也是满意的点了点头，而后玉手一挥。
其身后便传出“轰隆隆”的响声，那道高达数丈的大门，正在缓缓开启。
“还等什么？都不想通过考核了么？”看着呆滞的众弟子，苏柔嫣然一笑。
“冲啊~~~~”
一时间，阵阵欢呼响彻不断，上万名外门弟子，如脱缰野马一般，向大门内冲去。
楚枫跟随人流，一路向前，最终进入了一道深邃的岩洞之中。
这岩洞很辽阔，但却很昏暗，可视度极低，人们都知道潜伏的危险，随时可能降临。
“冲啊，为了四段武技，为了五株仙草，冲~~~”
然而总是有些人，要钱不要命，明知有危险，还是一马当先，连头都是不回，并且这种人还不在少数。

“唰唰唰”
可刚刚前行百米，阵阵破风之音便自前方传来，无数根银针自岩壁发出，如同暴雨一般射向人群。
“啊~~~~~~”
“呜哇~~~~”
一时间，各种惨叫响彻一片，冲在前方的弟子猝不及防，已是倒下大半。
可就算如此，人们还是既往如前，没有丝毫的退缩，拼命的洞穴深处狂奔。
因为他们知道，这银针虽然厉害，但却不会致命，毕竟是机关，对于灵武三重的人来说，只要小心一些，完全可以躲避。
而随着不断的深入，银针的数量也是越来越密集，并且时常打的人们措手不及。
在这种情况下，人群很快拉开了距离，跑在最前方的已不是浑水摸鱼之辈，而是杨天雨，段宇轩等高手之流。
不得不说，那杨天雨与段宇轩等人，的确不凡。
他人在那暴雨一般的银针中行走，需小心翼翼。
但他们却如履平地，哪里是闯机关阵，简直就是几个人在赛跑。
楚枫一直跟在他们身后，尾随在灵武三重的大军之中，这样做有两个原因。
第一，不想做出头鸟。
第二，他的情况很特殊，还不想太早暴露实力。
所以他在等待一个时机，一个所有人都看不见，但他却可以超越所有人的时机。
“段宇轩，枉你这么大年纪，竟跑不过我一个孩子，不觉得丢人么？”
“哼，小屁孩，修武一途，不论年龄只讲实力，要说大话，先赢了我再说。”
经过一段时间的穿梭，队伍的最前方，只剩下了两道身影，那便是段宇轩与杨天雨。
这两人都是灵武四重，一个天资卓越，一个经验老道，二人不分上下，火药味越来越足

因为他们知道，最大的竞争对手就是对方，只要赢过对方，那第一的奖励，便都是他们的。
“呼~。”突然，阵阵风声自前方传来。
定目观望，二人皆是大惊，不由得减缓了脚下的步伐，因为在前方，竟出现了浓郁的雾气。
这岩洞本就昏暗，再加上雾气，可视度就更低，这也大大增加了躲避机关的难度，哪怕是他们两个，也必须小心对待。
“好机会。”
可就所有人退缩之时，楚枫却是窃喜，他大步向前一踏，只听嗖的一声，整个人如离弦之箭般，向前方飞奔而去。
“唰。”
此刻段宇轩正专心躲避银针，一道黑影却自其身旁一闪而过，还不待他反应过来，那人已是消失不见。
“难道是幻觉?”
这样一幕，让段宇轩倍感吃惊，开始还以为是杨天雨，可是当发现杨天雨仍在不远处后，他却变得恍惚起来。
成功甩开所有人，楚枫也没了顾虑，他将速度提到了极致。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. “What exactly is it?” someone asked curiously.
"Does Elder Su Rou want to sacrifice himself?" What's more shameless is that she actually has wild dreams.
Although Su Rou is an elder, she is only 20 years old. Compared with the old antiques in the sect, she is more approachable. Because of this, many people speak without any scruples.
In response to everyone's speculation, Su Rou just smiled charmingly, stretched out five slender fingers, and said: "Five fairy grasses."
"What? Five fairy grasses?"
"Did I hear correctly? Is it the fairy grass, or five of them?" As soon as these words came out, the hall was in chaos, and everyone could not calm down.
The fairy grass is so precious that even the Chu family can only subsidize one plant per person every year.
For ordinary people, the fairy grass is a priceless treasure that has never been seen before.
Now the Qinglong Sect actually took out five plants, which was quite tempting for the outer disciples.
But for most people, they can only think about it, because they all know that the fairy grass has no chance with them.
On the other hand, those disciples who aimed directly at number one were eager to try and became even more excited.
Seeing that the disciples' momentum was so high, Su Rou nodded with satisfaction, and then waved her jade hand.
There was a "rumbling" sound behind him, and the door that was several feet high was slowly opening.
"What are you waiting for? Don't you want to pass the exam?" Looking at the stunned disciples, Su Rou smiled sweetly.
"Come on~~~~"
For a time, bursts of cheers resounded, and tens of thousands of outer disciples rushed into the gate like wild horses.
Chu Feng followed the flow of people and moved forward, finally entering a deep cave.
This cave is very vast, but it is very dark and has extremely low visibility. People all know that lurking dangers may come at any time.
"Come on, for the fourth level of martial arts, for the five fairy grasses, rush~~~"
However, there are always some people who want money rather than their lives. Even though they know there is danger, they still take the lead and never look back. And there are not a few such people.
"Swish, swish, swish"
But just after walking a hundred meters, the sound of breaking wind came from the front, and countless silver needles came out from the rock wall, shooting at the crowd like a heavy rain.
"Ah~~~~~~"
"Wow~~~~"
For a moment, all kinds of screams resounded. The disciples rushing in front were caught off guard and most of them fell down.
But even so, people continued as before, without flinching at all, running desperately deep into the cave.
Because they know that although this silver needle is powerful, it is not fatal. After all, it is a trap. For people with the third level of spiritual martial arts, they can completely avoid it as long as they are careful.
As the attack continues, the number of silver needles becomes more and more dense, and people are often caught off guard.
Under this situation, the crowd quickly distanced themselves, and those running at the front were no longer those who fish in troubled waters, but masters such as Yang Tianyu and Duan Yuxuan.
I have to say that Yang Tianyu, Duan Yuxuan and others are indeed extraordinary.
Others need to be careful when walking in the rain-like silver needles.
But they were walking on flat ground. Wherever they broke into the machine formation, it was just a few people racing.
Chu Feng has been following them, trailing in the third level Lingwu army. There are two reasons for this.
First, I don’t want to be the first to do it.
Second, his situation is very special and he doesn't want to reveal his strength too early.
So he is waiting for an opportunity, an opportunity that no one can see, but he can surpass everyone.
"Duan Yuxuan, at such an old age, you can't outrun my child. Don't you feel embarrassed?"
"Humph, little brat, in the journey of martial arts cultivation, no matter your age, you only care about your strength. If you want to talk big, you must win first before I speak."
After a period of shuttle, there were only two figures left at the front of the team, and that wasDuan Yuxuan and Yang Tianyu.
These two people are both at the fourth level of spiritual martial arts. One is extremely talented and the other is experienced.
Because they know that the biggest competitor is the other party. As long as they beat the other party, the first prize will be theirs.
"Hoo~." Suddenly, gusts of wind came from the front.
Looking intently, both of them were shocked and couldn't help but slow down their steps because a thick mist appeared in front of them.
The cave was already dark, and with the fog, the visibility was even lower, which also greatly increased the difficulty of avoiding the trap. Even the two of them had to be careful.
"Good opportunity."
But when everyone retreated, Chu Feng secretly rejoiced. He took a big step forward, and with a whooshing sound, he flew forward like an arrow from a string.
"Uh-huh."
At this moment, Duan Yuxuan was concentrating on avoiding the silver needle, but a black shadow flashed past him, and before he could react, the man had disappeared.
"Is it an illusion?"
Such a scene surprised Duan Yuxuan. He thought it was Yang Tianyu at first, but when he found that Yang Tianyu was still not far away, he became confused.
After successfully getting rid of everyone, Chu Feng no longer had any worries, and he raised his speed to the extreme.
